stateFields: Entries (a POL file's entries, read together: the value entry, its **del.<name> entry, the **deletevalues list and the key's **delvals / **delvals. marker)

states.name: Not configured
states.writtenAs: no entry for the value: no registry value, no POL entry, no REG record. A new empty POL store (New PolFile) starts every setting here.

states.name: Configured
states.writtenAs: a value entry with data and kind (SetValue). In a POL file it is a per-value state read beside the others: if a **del.<name> entry or a key marker is already in the file, SetValue leaves it there and the value entry, which sorts after **, wins when the file is read (WillDeleteValue 130-131).

states.name: Queued for deletion
states.writtenAs: POL file: an entry named **del.<value name> (DWord 32), or the value name listed in a **deletevalues entry (semicolon-separated). REG file: a value record with IsDeleter true. Never held in the registry, which deletes at once.

states.name: Key cleared
states.writtenAs: A per-key state, covering every value under one key, unlike the per-value states above. POL file: an entry named **delvals. (or **delvals) in the key; a **deletekeys entry clears each listed subkey when applied. REG file: a key record with IsDeleter true. Never held in the registry. ClearKey on an already cleared POL key removes the marker with the values and adds it back, so it stays cleared.
